    if vehicle_hint is None:
        vehicle_hint = 0

    customers = list(customers_set)

    def route_cost(route):
        if not route:
            return 0
        c = matrix[depot][route[0]] + matrix[route[-1]][depot]
        for i in range(len(route) - 1):
            c += matrix[route[i]][route[i + 1]]
        return c

    def total_cost(routes):
        return sum(route_cost(r) for r in routes)

    def try_two_opt(route):
        n = len(route)

            return route, False

        best_delta = 0
        improved = False

        # Deterministic first-improvement
        for i in range(n - 3):
            a = best[i]
            b = best[i + 1]
            dab = matrix[a][b]
            for j in range(i + 2, n - 1):
                c = best[j]
                d = best[j + 1]
                dcd = matrix[c][d]
                new_cost = matrix[a][c] + matrix[b][d]
                old_cost = dab + dcd
                delta = old_cost - new_cost
                if delta > best_delta:
                    # apply reverse (i+1..j)
                    new_route = best[:i + 1] + list(reversed(best[i + 1:j + 1])) + best[j + 1:]
                    return new_route, True
        return best, False

        if ncust == 0:
            return []

        routes = [[c] for c in customers]

                savings.append((s, i, j))
